entry.title: New: gewu-tools
entry.summary: Model-agnostic visual-inspection pipeline for text-only agents: page-by-page HTML screenshots plus a ready-made vision-subagent briefing contract (gewu_prep), then source-code truth verification of every finding (gewu_locate); validated on mimo-v2.5 & qwen3.7-plus. Exact install spec: github:nyantused-cpun/gewu-tools. Source event: awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin; changed: listed.
